Steven Smith’s fitness will be key, given that he has been dealing with a neck issue and did not come out to bat at his usual No. 4 position in this innings. South Africa’s seamers will get some much-deserved rest and return all guns blazing tomorrow, while Harmer will also be expected to make an impact. There is still no update on Anrich Nortje’s fitness following his suspected groin injury, but South Africa won’t be too worried about that for now. Tomorrow promises to be an enthralling day of Test cricket, and we will be there nice and early to bring you all the updates. Until then, good night and take care!
